verdict.rationale: Smithery is a platform with a REST API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no interactive reference or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The shutdown notice also says the docs tree was removed and there is no longer a documented API surface to explore. Server pages where users can 'try' an MCP are a different feature, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
